                                     ORDER OF REFERRAL

       The Public Utility Commission of Texas refers this docket to the State Office of
Administrative Hearings (SOAH) and requests the assignment of an administrative law judge to
conduct a hearing and issue a proposal for decision if necessary to resolve any issues that are
contested by the parties.

       The Commission will issue in this docket a preliminary order that will contain a list of the
issues to be addressed in this docket, as well as any necessary statement of Commission policy,
precedent, or position on any threshold legal or policy issues relevant to this proceeding. Parties
must not file responses to any pleading submitted in response to this Order, unless specifically
requested.

       All subsequent pleadings in this docket must contain both the SOAH and the Commission
docket numbers to allow for efficient processing. Filing of pleadings is governed by 16 Texas
Administrative Code (TAC) § 22.71, the new version of which became effective
December 10, 2025. Parties must make filings in accordance with 16 TAC § 22.71(j) regarding
confidential items to be provided.

       Service is governed by 16 TAC § 22.74. It will be incumbent on all other parties to obtain
a copy of the pleading or document by accessing the Interchange on the Commission’s website
(https://interchange.puc.texas.gov/filer). When a party files a document with the Commission, that
party is also required to serve (i.e., provide a copy of that document to) every other party.

       The Commission’s preliminary order will provide a list of issues and areas that must be
addressed in this proceeding as required by Texas Government Code § 2003.049(e) and any
necessary statement of Commission policy, precedent, or position on threshold issues, or

§ 2001.058(c). The Commission will consider and possibly adopt a preliminary order in this
docket at the open meeting currently scheduled to convene on December 12, 2025.

          Signed at Austin, Texas the 10th day of December 2025.
                                                             PUBLIC UTILITY COMMISSION OF TEXAS



                                                             Electronically signed by Shelah Cisneros
